# Eukaryotes

## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. Eukaryotes were pulled from the Kraken results. Read abundances were transformed to relative abundances for eukaryotes due to the low number detected. 

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(stringr)
library(phyloseq)
library(metagMisc)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(knitr)
library(GUniFrac)
library(ggrepel)
library(MMUPHin)
library(ggprism)
library(ggbreak)
library(microbial)
library(devtools)
library(pairwiseAdonis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(ggtext)
library(ggtext)
library(veganEx)
library(kableExtra)
library(pixiedust)
library(downloadthis)
```

## 2. Data processing 

### Import data

Examine raw data and make phyloseq object. 


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The input data is formatted such that the first column contains rows of species, followed by columns "kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU" to be used for taxonomy in phyloseq object. OTU is in this case is species. 

data<-read.csv("Tax_euks.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)


taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU")]
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL 

```

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The first column in the metadata contains rows of sample IDs that correspond to the samples in the input data. Each subsequent column is a different piece of metadata.

metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)
tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))
phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)


hist(log10(taxa_sums(phylo_raw)))

```

### Filtering


```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 3, prev.trh=0.25, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")
phylo


```

<br>

> **Notes:**: Filtering helped distribution bias of taxa. 

<br><br>

### Rarefaction curve

Evaluating the number of reads to rarefy to to normalization for differences in sequencing depth. 

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}


summary(sample_sums(phylo))

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))

```


```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(ampvis2) 
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv")
#phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
y<-amp_load(phylo_df, metadata, taxa)

rarecurve<-amp_rarecurve(
  y,
  stepsize = 1000,
  color_by = NULL,
  facet_by = "Timepoint",
  facet_scales = "free_x"
)
rarecurve




```

<br>

> **Notes:**: Low diversity of eukaryotes sequenced. Going with relative abundance for these normalized. 

<br><br>

### Calculating alpha diversity

```{r}


## calculate alpha diversity


phy_alphadiv <- estimate_richness(phylo)
otu_table <- otu_table(t(phylo))
evenness<- diversity(otu_table)/log(specnumber(otu_table))
chao1 <- t(estimateR(otu_table))[,2]
all_alphadivs <- data.frame(phy_alphadiv, evenness, chao1)
update_sample_data <- merge(sample_data(phylo), all_alphadivs, by=0)
rownames(update_sample_data) <- update_sample_data$Row.names
update_sample_data$Row.names <- NULL
sample_data(phylo) <- update_sample_data
metadata<-update_sample_data

```

```{r}

all_alphadivs %>% kable(caption="<center><strong>Table X. Alpha diversity.<center><strong>") %>% kable_styling() %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)

```

## 3. Beta diversity 

Examined differences between time point (Baseline, Day 0, Day 2, Day 8, Day 14, Day 28) using permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA).

### 3.1 Permanova 


```{r}

phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(phylo_df~Timepoint, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in eukaryote composition using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


```

```{r}
library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVA-results-euks-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

<br><br><br>


```{r}

canberra<-pairwise.adonis2(phylo_df~Timepoint, data=metadata, method="canberra")
results_df <- do.call(rbind, canberra)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in eukaryote composition using Canberra distance.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))

```

## 4. Genus level analysis

### 4.1 PERMANOVA

Used permutational multivariate analysis of variance (PERMANOVA) to assess differences in microbial community composition between groups. 


```{r}

genus<-tax_glom(phylo, "genus")
genus_df<-phyloseq_to_df(genus, addtax=T)
#write.csv(genus_df, "Genus_counts_normalized.csv")
rownames(genus_df)<-genus_df[,"genus"]
genus_df[,c("OTU","kingdom","phylum","order","family","class","species","genus","OTU.1")]<-NULL

genus_df<-as.data.frame(t(genus_df))
genus_bray<-pairwise.adonis2(genus_df~Timepoint, data=metadata)


results_df <- do.call(rbind, genus_bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in eukaryotic composition at genus level using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>") %>% kable_styling()%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black")) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "650px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)
```

```{r}
library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant eukaryotes",
    output_extension = ".csv",
    button_label = "Download Results",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

## 5. Differential abundance 

Used Maaslin2 to look for differentially abundant eukaryotic genera between timepoints after BSS and day 0 using a linear model ("LM") and log transformation. SubjectID and Sequence Run were incorporated as random effects. 

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

library(Maaslin2)

metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = genus_df,
  input_metadata = metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_Day0_genus",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results



table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])

table_sub<- table %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4_day0<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)
table_sub4_day0$genus<-table_sub4_day0$feature
taxa[,c("species","OTU")]<-NULL
taxa_uniq<-data.frame(unique(taxa))
DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table_sub4_day0, taxa_uniq, by="genus", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)

```

<br><br>

```{r}

DAA_taxa_select<-DAA_taxa[,c(1,4,5,8:11)]

DAA_taxa_select <- DAA_taxa_select[order(DAA_taxa_select$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

DAA_taxa_select$qval<-formatC(DAA_taxa_select$qval, format = "e", digits = 1)
DAA_taxa_select$coef<-round(DAA_taxa_select$coef, digits=2)





dust(DAA_taxa_select) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant eukaryotes at the genus level at day 2 compared to day 0.<strong>") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T) 

library(downloadthis)
DAA_taxa_select %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant eukaryote genera",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )


```

### 5.1 Eukaryote barchart

```{r}



DAA_taxa$phylum<- factor(DAA_taxa$phylum,
    levels = c('Apicomplexa','Ascomycota','Bacillariophyta','Basidiomycota','Euglenozoa','Parabasalia'), ordered = TRUE)

DAA_taxa<-DAA_taxa %>% filter(value == "Day 2")
DAA_taxa$genus <- factor(DAA_taxa$genus, levels = DAA_taxa$genus[order(DAA_taxa$phylum, decreasing=TRUE)])


library(RColorBrewer); library(scales)
nb.cols <- 6
mycolors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"))(nb.cols)

DAA_taxa<- DAA_taxa %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("_", " ", genus))




DAA_taxa$updated_text<- factor(DAA_taxa$updated_text, levels = DAA_taxa$updated_text[order(DAA_taxa$phylum, DAA_taxa$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

stacked_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x = coef, y = updated_text, fill=phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="bottom")+ylab(NULL)

#stacked_species



```

```{r}

DAA_taxa$qval_adj<-(-log10(DAA_taxa$qval))

bubble_species<-ggplot(DAA_taxa, aes(x=value, y=updated_text, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=phylum))+scale_size(range=c(2,5), "p val")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

#bubble_species


ggexport(stacked_species+bubble_species, filename="Stacked_plot_genus_euks_w_qval_v2.pdf",width=6, height=8)

```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=8, fig.cap="**Figure X. Differentially abundant eukaryotic genera (effect size > 1 or <  - 1) colored by phylum 2 days (day 2) after compared to day before (day 0) BSS administration. Significance represents -log10 of adjusted p value after multiple comparisons (< 0.05). The greater the circle the more statistically significant.**"}

figure<-stacked_species+bubble_species

figure
